Iris (Docs): quick thread re: PR #3890  snippets cleanup. Found 3 small but important issues across Python/TS/Go examples -> want to fix in one micro-PR before merge.
Sam K: list them?
Iris (Docs): 1) Python streaming example uses 'async for' directly (no cleanup) which can leave background tasks/sockets alive in some runtimes. 2) TS retry example shows backoff config but lacks a maxDelay/attempt cap. 3) Go pagination loop doesn't check for an empty cursor and can end up refetching the first page repeatedly on some backends.
Tobias (SDK): all sound legit. Short, conservative fixes preferred.
Iris (Docs): proposed Python change -> prefer async context manager + tiny fallback note:

```py
# preferred: ensures resources are cleaned up automatically
async with client.stream(prompt) as stream:
    async for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk)
# fallback for older SDKs:
# stream = client.stream(prompt)
# async for c in stream: print(c)
# await client.close()  # ensure background tasks are stopped
```

Sam K: please add an explicit import of asyncio in the snippet so copy-paste in REPL/docs is clearer.
Iris (Docs): done in the patch.
Iris (Docs): TS retry suggestion (opinionated defaults + abort on 4xx):

```ts
// conservative defaults to avoid long waits
const retryCfg = { baseMs: 200, factor: 2, maxDelayMs: 4000, attempts: 6, jitter: true };
await sdk.generate({ prompt }, { retry: retryCfg });
// note: abort immediately on 4xx (non-retriable) responses
```

Tobias (SDK): sounds good. Add a one-liner explaining tradeoffs (latency vs success).
Iris (Docs): added comment.
Iris (Docs): Go pagination safe loop suggestion:

```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for {
    if !resp.HasMore() {
        break
    }
    next := resp.NextCursor()
    if next == "" {
        // backend returned empty cursor; stop to avoid repeating first page
        break
    }
    resp, _ = client.List(ctx, next)
}
```

Asha P: can you add a 3-line unit test in examples_test.go that simulates NextCursor() == "" so the loop is covered? That'll reduce flakiness when folks copy the pattern.
Iris (Docs): yep, adding a tiny test that returns a mock response with empty cursor and asserts loop exits after one page.
